lines.text: Soft light fills @cafe_morning. Steam rises from the espresso machine.
The barista slides a cup across the counter.
He takes the first sip and closes his eyes.
His shoulders drop. A slow smile spreads.
Outside the window, the street wakes up.
He opens his eyes and nods to the barista.

writes.note: I drafted a short, quiet scene from your line, ending on his first-sip moment.

reply.rationale: Kept the brief's beat (slide, sip, eyes closed) and added a short reaction and release, all visual, about 14 s by rule 10. Used only the listed refs.
